_doc: Talking to a copy (E, right click, gamepad Y, the touch talk button). range: px from the player to the nearest copy you can talk to. The box: margin px from the screen edges, height px, lines of prose per page, linePx between lines; text types out at charsPerSecond, holding pauseMs after punctuation. staleMinutes: a traits.tell older than this asks the copy for a fresh one when the box opens (if the mind is there). thoughts: how many notes the THOUGHTS pages show; letters: how many letters to you, and one latest received and one latest sent. blip: the copy's voice per typed letter (minGapMs between blips, seconds long, vol).
